message: Model source registry: clients can register bring-your-own-key model sources with the host through the client-dispatchable `root/modelSourceSet` and `root/modelSourceRemoved` actions. A registered `ModelSource` carries its `format`, its `definition`, and a `nonce` for it: re-registering the same `provider`, `format`, and `nonce` keeps the source's status and credential. Agents advertise the formats they read as `ModelSourceFormatInfo` entries in `AgentCapabilities.modelSourceRegistration`. Clients deliver each source's credential with a `modelSource` `authenticate` target, naming the key with `authenticate`'s `accountId`. The host reports status, `credentialResource`, and `accountId` with the host-only `root/modelSourceStateChanged` action, using model-source-specific auth reasons (`required`, `expired`, `rejected`, `revoked`). Requests and turns that need an unavailable source fail with the new `AhpErrorCodes.ModelSourceUnavailable` (`-32013`), which a turn's error part carries in the new optional `ErrorInfo.errorCode`.
